situation:
You are to assume the role of district marketing manager at CROSSROADS BURGER CO., a drive-thru burger chain with two hundred restaurants. The vice president of franchise operations (judge) has asked to meet with you about how one franchisee should spend a local marketing budget.

CROSSROADS BURGER CO. merged with BIG SKY BURGERS eight months ago, and the two menus, two order systems and two supplier lists have still not been combined. The franchisee who owns four restaurants in your district controls a local marketing budget of forty thousand dollars for the year, and has used part of it to pay quarterly bonuses that recognize the drive-thru crews for speed and accuracy.

The franchisee has asked you which vendor to hire. NORTHFIELD RESEARCH, the chain's longtime research vendor, would survey the district's guests and build a campaign for close to the whole budget, ending the crew bonuses for the year. SIDEWALK MEDIA, a new agency, would do the work for a third of that price using food-preference data it has already collected, leaving the bonuses funded.

SIDEWALK MEDIA has never worked with a drive-thru chain, and its data was gathered before the merger changed the menu, so a campaign built on it could promote items the restaurants no longer sell. Hiring NORTHFIELD RESEARCH would avoid that risk, at the cost of the crew bonuses in a year when the crews are learning two menus at once.

The vice president of franchise operations (judge) wants you to recommend one vendor and explain how the choice would be presented to the franchisee. The vice president (judge) will begin the role-play by greeting you and asking to hear your ideas. After you have presented and have answered the vice president's (judge's) questions, the vice president (judge) will thank you for your work.
judgeCharacterization:
You are to assume the role of vice president of franchise operations at CROSSROADS BURGER CO., a drive-thru burger chain with two hundred restaurants. Business background is the same as the situation above.

You have asked the district marketing manager (participant) to recommend whether the franchisee should hire NORTHFIELD RESEARCH or SIDEWALK MEDIA with the local marketing budget, and to explain how that choice would be presented to the franchisee.

During the course of the role-play you are to ask the participant the following questions:
judgeQuestions: Who does this choice land hardest on?
How should the franchisee hear about it?
